method.export_lag: FFT cross-correlation at 8kHz in five 2s windows per episode; resolution 0.125ms.
method.video_sampling: First sample at or after planned cut: ceil(cut*30)/30; latest seam 06/07 confirmed by decoding frames 1127 and 1128.
method.active_cut_screen: 25ms RMS immediately before and after source cut; flag above -50dBFS is an investigation screen, not a speech/word classifier.
method.limitation: Native word timestamps are estimates. No perceptual listening; ASR and waveform evidence are separately retained.
